footnotes: The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Mar 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 0.2% to $15.1B in fiscal 2026 (ended Mar 31, 2026). Gross margin was 21.8%, versus 20.9% a year earlier, and operating income fell 4.8% to $414M, a 2.7% margin.
Net income fell 21.4% to $198M, or $0.85 per share. Operating cash flow was $948M and free cash flow $340M, versus $337M; Kyndryl returned $304M through buybacks.
sources: Kyndryl Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
